title: Quick beef and spinach bowl
summary: Quick beef and spinach bowl is a japanese dinner built around lean beef frying steak and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Quick beef and spinach bowl chopped before the pan goes on. Pat lean beef frying steak dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook lean beef frying steak until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook baby spinach and tamari until hot and lightly browned. Return lean beef frying steak and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Quick beef and spinach bowl, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Quick beef and spinach bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
